fato_historico: 1965: Several U.S. states and parts of Canada are hit by a series of blackouts lasting up to 13 hours in the Northeast blackout of 1965.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to find illumination even when shadows seem to linger. Just as a sudden flicker of light returns after a long darkness, your mind may feel a surge of clarity today. It is a good time to connect with friends and share your ideas, letting your intellectual brilliance chase away any lingering uncertainty.
frase_do_dia: Seek the light within you, for it shines brightest during unexpected shifts.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle of transformation leading to a brighter new beginning.
conselho: Consider sharing your unique perspective to help others find their way today.
